programme.title: 2025 Stanley Cup Final
programme.desc: The defending Stanley Cup champion Panthers visit a familiar foe in the Oilers for Game 1 of the Stanley Cup Final. Florida makes its third straight trip to the final. The Panthers beat the Oilers in seven games in 2024 after leading the series 3-0.

programme.title: 2025 Stanley Cup Final
programme.desc: The Oilers try to press their advantage as they host the Panthers for Game 2 of the Stanley Cup Final. Leon Draisaitl's second goal of Game 1 came on the power play with 31 seconds remaining in the first overtime frame for a 4-3 Edmonton win.

programme.title: 2025 Stanley Cup Final
programme.desc: The 2025 Stanley Cup Final, tied at 1-1, takes the Panthers and Oilers to Florida for Game 3. After Corey Perry scored with 18 seconds left to tie the game, Brad Marchand broke hearts with his double-overtime tally to give Florida a 5-4 Game 2 win.

programme.title: 2025 Stanley Cup Final
programme.desc: The Panthers try to put a stranglehold on their Stanley Cup Final with the Oilers in this Game 4. Brad Marchand scored another key goal in Game 3, striking in the opening minute as Florida cruised to a 6-1 victory and a 2-1 series advantage.

programme.title: 2025 Stanley Cup Final
programme.desc: The Stanley Cup Final returns north, with the Oilers and Panthers playing Game 5 tied at 2-2. A seesaw duel saw Florida's Sam Reinhart send Game 4 to overtime with 20 seconds left, but Leon Draisaitl scored after 11 minutes for a 5-4 Edmonton win.

programme.title: 2025 Stanley Cup Final
programme.desc: The Panthers aim to claim their second straight Stanley Cup in Game 6 against the Oilers. Florida made an early 2-0 lead in Game 5 hold up for an eventual 5-2 victory over Edmonton. Brad Marchand scored the first and third goals for the Panthers.

programme.title: Bundesliga. "Bayern" - "Leipzig"
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: LaLiga. "Villarreal" - "Girona"
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. programme.title: Steal
programme.desc: When money is involved, trust is a big word. Four Filipinas based in Japan will learn the hard truth about money and trust as they get entangled in their own schemes.

programme.title: Buhay Kamao
programme.desc: Pepe, did not want anything to do with boxing but the easy money involved in the sport attracted him when he was desperate to pay off a long standing debt. Little did he know that the match was just the beginning of a series of tests.

programme.title: Penduko
programme.desc: Hoping to profit from his occult gifts, a mystic joins a shadowy society and must confront his own darkness as he finds his place in the underworld.

programme.title: Momzillas
programme.desc: Clara and Minerva, the two women who shared the same man, meet again when their son and daughter, respectively, are about to marry each other.

programme.title: Ang Manananggal na Nahahati ang Puso
programme.desc: A barrio lass agrees to be the subject of a man's research about aswangs. He falls for her but hides his feelings knowing that she's an aswang.

programme.title: Hello, Universe!
programme.desc: Ariel (Janno Gibbs), a middle-aged man full of regrets, gets another chance to rewrite his past when he meets a magical figure who gives him the life he has always dreamt of. But at what cost?

programme.title: Habangbuhay
programme.desc: A sheltered girl, who grew up in a very protective family, is asking a boy to fight for their love. If only he was not too consumed by his own battles.

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: Ikaw Lamang
programme.desc: A charming, light-hearted tale about the ups and downs of growing up, and the joys and pains of young love.

programme.title: Paligayahin Mo Ako
programme.desc: Susan and Zeny are sisters who have long endured their father's uselessness. Together with their mother, they have struggled to keep their family afloat by raising ducks.

programme.title: Sex Drive
programme.desc: A story of two girls who take off on a road trip to follow a guy. During the trip, they fall into all sorts of adventures and misadventures involving a handsome stranger and a mysterious killer who is being haunted by the police.

programme.title: Huwag Mong Takasan Ang Batas
programme.desc: Nelson used to live in the boondocks as an insurgent citizen. But soon he decides to mend his ways and start life anew. He then promises himself that he will live a peaceful life and give his sister Nene, the best he could provide.

programme.title: Hindi Tayo Pwede
programme.desc: Gabby (Lovi Poe) finds love in a man who is also named Gabby (Tony Labrusca) and shares a long and deep friendship with Dennis (Marco Gumabao).

programme.title: Booba
programme.desc: Rufa Mae stars in this comedy as Booba as she endeavors in the metropolis to fulfill her promise to her dying mother that she will find her jealous and insecure sister who run away from home.

programme.title: Anong Ganap?
programme.desc: Being in on the entertainment circle is quick and easy on PBO's Anong Ganap? Presented by the gorgeous entertainment anchor ng bayan, Phoemela Baranda.

programme.title: Isang Lahi, Isang Dugo Sa Lupang Pangako
programme.desc: \"Lupang Pangako\" or Land of Promise --- that is what people call Mindanao because of its vast untapped natural resources. As such, several people want to claim it for themselves.

programme.title: ABNKKBSNPLAko? The Movie
programme.desc: The film follows the life of the character named Roberto Ong (Jericho Rosales). It checks the four phases of his life. From childhood memories, his best times in high school, his years in college and until his life as an working adult.

programme.title: Real Life Fiction
programme.desc: An actor with an illustrious career decides to write, direct, and act in a film that will inevitably bring him closer to his own demise before revealing that his truth may actually be far from what he has become.

programme.title: Annie B.
programme.desc: Annie (Jolina Magdangal) tells her story and it is true that life is a fairy tale. And she lives her fairy tale day by day.

programme.title: More Than Blue
programme.desc: K (JC Santos) and Cream (Yassi Pressman) believe they're soulmates. When K finds out that he's dying, he thinks setting her free would be best for her.

programme.title: Tulak ng Bibig, Kabig ng Dibdib
programme.desc: After spending a couple of years behind bars, Lando wins back his freedom. Desperate for a job, he agrees to work for Mariel despite his negative impression of her.

programme.title: Mang Jose
programme.desc: Having the ability of energy absorption and redirection, Mang Jose covertly saves people only if they rent him out. One day, Tope rents Mang Jose to help him save his mother who has been abducted by mysterious troopers of King Ina.

programme.title: Maria Labo
programme.desc: A popular urban legend about a woman who devours human flesh.

programme.title: Tragic Theater
programme.desc: A team of exorcists are sent into an old theater that is rumored to have been the site of a great tragedy during its construction.

programme.title: My Bakit List
programme.desc: Bombarded with so much why's in her life, Dess (Louise delos Reyes) embarks on a soul searching journey. Unknown to her, she is about to face the biggest why of her life when she accidentally bumps into her ex-boyfriend who left her without any explanation.

programme.title: Chain Mail
programme.desc: A usual chain mail is forwarded to a group of people. Some pass it while others ignore. One dies and is followed by series of sudden and unexplainable deaths of others. Soon after, a revelation begins to unfold, the chain mail is cursed and so Sandra (Shy Carlos) has to find the origin and mystery behind to stop the misfortunes.

programme.title: Beks Days of Our Lives
programme.desc: Richardson (Chad Kinis), Reggie (Lassy Marquez) and Melvin (MC Calaquian) have have been friends for many years despite working in different fields. They decided to go on a vacation, finding themselves in hilarious situations. Everything's going perfectly well until the night Reggie collapses.

programme.title: Masamang Ugat
programme.desc: Two brothers are separated after their mother dies. One becomes a cop (Mikey Arroyo), the other an assassin (Ace Vergel). The cop ambitiously wants to bring down a drug lord supported by politicians, while the assassin works for the same drug lord.

programme.title: Panabla
programme.desc: Panabla.

programme.title: The Gifted
programme.desc: Childhood best friends who are both geniuses in school eventually become bittersweet rivals for campus athlete Mark Ferrer.

programme.title: Baliktaran
programme.desc: A hilarious comedy about a couple switching roles to make their marriage work.

programme.title: Spellbound
programme.desc: A Filipino adaptation of a South Korean film about Yuri (Bela Padilla), a woman haunted by ghosts after a car accident. Victor (Marco Gumabao), a street magician, turns her experiences into a popular horror-magic performance.

programme.title: Shoot! Shoot! Di Ko Siya Titigilan!
programme.desc: When an aspiring actor practices his role as a billionaire out loud, gossip about him being rich spreads like wildfire. Now, the girls and the goons are after him.

programme.title: Penduko
programme.desc: Hoping to profit from his occult gifts, a mystic joins a shadowy society and must confront his own darkness as he finds his place in the underworld.

programme.title: Room 213
programme.desc: The story follows the endangered relationship of an architect and his wife, a photographer. After being married for 10 years, they have lost all emotional connections with each other.

programme.title: Ang Babaeng Walang Pakiramdam
programme.desc: A woman diagnosed with a rare congenital disease that makes her incapable of feeling physical and emotional pain meets a man with cleft palate who makes her feel love like she never has before.

programme.title: Tatarin
programme.desc: An adaptation of the popular play of Nick Joaquin,Tatarin tackles the celebration of a sacred feast that liberates.

programme.title: Maria
programme.desc: When a former BlackRose cartel assassin deliberately betrays them by refusing to complete her mission, the cartel orders her execution. Unbeknownst to them, she fakes her own death and is able to create a new life of her own.

programme.title: Alas-Dose
programme.desc: A mad bomber is on the loose and the bomb squad leader Col. Titus Varona (Cesar Montano) is at his wits' end.

programme.title: Diary ng Panget
programme.desc: Eya (Nadine Lustre) and Cross (James Reid) didn't get along at first, their relationship becomes complicated but soon, they fall in love with each other.

programme.title: Pusong Mamon
programme.desc: A funny heart warming story about three extraordinary people and their equally extraordinary relationship.

programme.title: Wala Ka Nang Lupang Tatapakan
programme.desc: A soldier whose dedication to duty is unwavering, Daniel finds himself going against authority when his wife and son were murdered. With the local police unwilling to go after the perpetrator of the crime, Daniel decides to take matters into his own hands.

programme.title: Bakit Lahat ng Gwapo May Boyfriend?
programme.desc: Kylie (Anne Curtis), a wedding planner has had a long string of boyfriends. Unfortunately for her, they've all been gay.

programme.title: A Hard Day
programme.desc: Dingdong Dantes (Detective Edmund Villon) plays a crooked policeman involved in a hit-and-run accident. John Arcilla (Lieutenant Ace Franco) plays another officer who tries to blackmail him.

programme.title: Real Life Fiction
programme.desc: An actor with an illustrious career decides to write, direct, and act in a film that will inevitably bring him closer to his own demise before revealing that his truth may actually be far from what he has become.

programme.title: Walang Kapalit
programme.desc: A marriage gone sour with the husband leaving the wife, taking along a minor daughter and lying to her about her mother. Meanwhile, each carries a relationship with other parties. Deciding to forego their annulment case, they commit to give their marriage a second try.

programme.title: Patayan Files: Ang Pinakamalaking Murder Cases ng Dekada '90
programme.desc: Cheche Lazaro's Probe Archives goes in depth on the controversy behind the gruesome crimes that shocked the entire country during the 90s.

programme.title: Rigodon
programme.desc: Rigodon tackles about secret lives, hidden passions, deceit, betrayal, vengeance, and peeping eyes.

programme.title: Darkroom
programme.desc: A group of teenage friends who seeks the thrill of ghost-hunting, and stumbles upon an old camera. As they carelessly play with it, they unknowingly summon the demon that exists inside.
Anton and Erika have been a couple for 12 years already. While he's not yet ready to get married, Erika waits until he is and lovingly devotes her time to him.

programme.title: Ratratan
programme.desc: A peace-loving man is forced to live a life of violence when his daughter is kidnapped by a group of armed men. Unable to rely on law enforcers to go after the perpetrators, he decides to take matters into his own hand.
